d.ko: The Loopler is a roguelite deckbuilder about a slot car driving in mesmerizing loops. Pick cards, place gates, and collect charms. Settle into the loop as numbers go up and dopamine fills your brain. See how far you can go in the pursuit of infinity.
d.en: The Loopler is a roguelite deckbuilder about a slot car driving in mesmerizing loops. Pick cards, place gates, and collect charms. Settle into the loop as numbers go up and dopamine fills your brain. See how far you can go in the pursuit of infinity.
d.zh: The Loopler 是一款以在迷人的环形赛道上飞驰的槽车为主题的Roguelite卡牌构建游戏。挑选卡牌、布置闸门、收集护身符。随着分数不断攀升，多巴胺充盈大脑，沉浸于这无尽的循环之中。在追求无限的征途中，看看你能走多远。
